authority: Supplied unchanged Beta1.7.3 client archive; original JVM CPU observations at authored IBlockAccess boundaries.
code_hash_definition: SHA-256 of exactly the code_length instruction bytes inside each Code attribute; descriptors, access flags and classfile hashes are separate.
record_hash_definition: ASCII complete ordered comparison records joined by LF with a final LF; only the two exact Block bootstrap log lines are excluded.
coverage_limit: Record identity for the authored CPU cases only. Class/method pins establish identity and do not assert execution or equivalence of every pinned method.
